name: pylance-tooling
description: Use the Pylance tools for Python work: gather verified language facts (types, diagnostics, references, signatures, unresolved imports, debugger state), run scoped automated refactorings with preview first, and check Pylance settings and diagnostics against its documentation. Falls back to the type checker, a snippet or a test when Pylance is unavailable. Load when editing Python with Pylance available or when a Pylance refactoring or documentation claim is needed.
